questions.question: A mixture of milk and water is in the ratio 7 : 3. When 20 litres of the mixture are removed and replaced with water, the ratio becomes 7 : 5. The initial quantity of the mixture was (litres)
questions.explanation: Milk after removal = 0.7(T − 20). New milk fraction = 7/12. So 0.7T − 14 = 7T/12, giving T = 120.
